prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: All-token lambda gain +.4406…+.5296 with separate source Tc+5.218 K, positive optical Gamma and no path negatives support finite-source pairing. Geoopt explicitly reports BFGS failure yet final force .000162 eV/A and near-zero coarse stress; fine force .03397 and stress .041 GPa remain uncertainties. This qualifies only source-coarse basin, not converged fine geometry.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.00014912399568134507 eV/Å, pressure -0.0 GPa; fine force 0.03397455998160851 eV/Å, pressure -0.027000000000000003 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.
unknowns: Experimental superconductivity in this exact state
Direct support for approximately 300 K at ambient pressure

proposed_contribution.intervention: W-to-Nb role construction in TiTa2X. coupled chemistry/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Resolve existing fine residual-force direction and paired orbital/mode contributions against TiTa2W. Favorable: internal displacement uncertainty does not reverse role gain; adverse: relevant relaxation/channel response reverses it; ambiguous: no matched mode evidence.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
